name: 数量付き注文明細
prompt:
Edit the supplied first candidate with only two local corrections. Preserve its overall 390 × 178 row frame, Japanese wording and prices, positions, white background, green unit-price accent, quantity 1, disabled light-gray minus, and enabled dark plus.

1. Add the missing Japanese delete label 「削除」 at the top-right of the product header, aligned like the Japanese native mock (right edge about x=374, baseline around y=31), in Meiryo Regular 12 px / 16 px line height. Do not substitute an X icon.
2. Reduce the black cap inside its existing 44 × 44 px image tile to match the original front-photo crop's scale: the cap should occupy about 42% of the tile width, with the same white breathing room as the source. Preserve the front view and embroidered 「Mobbin」 mark; do not add back/side views or a collage.

Keep the item title 「クラシックキャップ」, variant 「ブラック」, 「数量」, quantity 「1」, unit line 「¥2,499 × 1」, and right-aligned total 「¥2,499」 exactly. Keep the source lower-bound state: minus glyph very light gray, plus glyph dark. Preserve the clean white 390 × 178 frame and restrained border.

Do not change anything else from attempt 1. Output only this single Japanese order row. Do not add a whole cart screen, another item/color, checkout/delivery, navigation, header, extra text, or background tint. Keep the exact source photo appearance as closely as possible.
reviewNotes: Selected attempt 2. The 390x178 row has exact Japanese title, variant, delete label, quantity and yen prices; minus is correctly disabled and plus enabled. The front cap scale matches the reference better than attempt 1, but ImageGen reconstructs the cap photo and the embroidered Mobbin wordmark drifts when enlarged. Candidate remains needs-correction; no third generation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
